assessments.reasoning: Section 1.2 explicitly allows arbitrary structural nesting of procedures, describes their declaration placement and points to the worked example on the next physical page.

challenge.method: Compared §1.2 with §1.1's one-level SETL contrast and Figure 1's combination of a nested declaration and recursion. Checked the distinction between lexical enclosure and recursive calls.
challenge.results: The nesting permission refers to definitions inside definitions. The example has a nested procedure that also calls itself. Its call depth and resource consumption are different questions from declaration depth.

limitations: The finding concerns Report 490's language structure. It yields no bound on physical memory, stacks or individual compilers.
